tool.verification: Matches publisher GitHub asset digest and HTTPS-fetched SHA256SUMS; GPG signature not verified; no global install.

redaction: Public stream copies replace OS user/host names and UID/GID details. Original bytes stay at each rawPrivatePath;raw and public hashes are distinct. Diagnostic no-lock cat calls are observers,not coordination-qualified operations.
scope: Local generated repo,short live same-host locks,controlled stdin,SIGINT,SIGKILL and one stopped published-exclusive candidate. No age expiry,remote/backend faults,corruption/repair or arbitrary process containment proof.
